description: Fork of exp742 (bf16 unembedder + xent fix, drifted +9 mb at step 2400 before being killed). Single change: device_batch_size 24 -> 48 (so grad_accum drops 2 -> 1). Tests whether grad_accum=2 was interacting with bf16 grad rounding to amplify the drift. Same effective batch tokens (24576), same LR schedule, same 4000 steps. Expected memory: dbs=48 ~35 GB activations (exp737 v2 dbs=24 peaked at 17.8 GB). Compare to exp737 v2 = 1.3872 (with fp32 head AND dbs=24 grad_accum=2). If exp743 closes the drift, grad_accum was the culprit.
